title: Post-incident observability: add per-pool inflight metrics, KV-cache visibility, and tracing tags after Dedicated capacity spike
creator: Maya Chen
description: Summary: On 2026-02-27 we experienced a Dedicated capacity event during a customer load test that caused elevated tail latency and periodic request drops for a subset of customers. The incident was triggered by an unexpected shift in request concurrency to a single GPU pool where inflight request queues grew beyond design assumptions. Detection was delayed because the Console dashboards lacked per-pool inflight_request and per-GPU queue depth metrics, and tracing did not include model_variant and routing_policy tags, which obscured fallback behavior. Root cause: (1) a scheduling decision concentrated a high fraction of burst traffic to a single pool (smart-routing policy regression), (2) runtime did not expose per-pool inflight metrics to Prometheus, and (3) tracing instrumentation omitted model variant and fallback reason tags, making it hard to attribute latency to fallbacks. Observability gaps found: missing metrics (inflight_requests_per_gpu, queue_depth_per_worker, kv_cache_hit_rate_per_model_variant), poor dashboards (no per-pool SLO heatmap, noisy aggregate charts), and tracing gaps (no model_variant, no fallback_reason, missing request route tags). Impact: customer-facing latency spikes for three enterprise tenants and one short outage for Dedicated customers that required manual capacity redistribution.
action_items: Add and export per-pool and per-gpu metrics to Prometheus: inflight_requests_per_gpu, queue_depth_per_worker, and worker_backpressure_seconds. Owner: Rafael Ortiz. Due: 2026-03-12. Notes: runtime PR will add counters and gauges; include label set {pool_id, gpu_id, model_id, model_variant}.

Instrument KV cache with per-model and per-variant hit/miss counters and expose kv_cache_hit_rate_per_model_variant. Owner: Priya Nambiar. Due: 2026-03-18. Notes: ensure low-overhead aggregation and include sample rate for high-throughput models.

Add tracing tags to runtime spans: model_variant, routing_policy, fallback_reason, and pool_id. Owner: Daniel Park. Due: 2026-03-10. Notes: update OpenTelemetry schema and runtime tracing utils; bump minor version of tracing lib in runtime client.

Create Console dashboard templates: Dedicated Pool SLO heatmap, Per-GPU queue depth, and KV cache health panel. Owner: UX Observability (Design + Console). Due: 2026-03-16. Notes: include per-customer filter and link to playbooks.

Implement alerting runbook and SLO alerts: fire if inflight_requests_per_gpu > threshold for 3m OR queue_depth_per_worker increases by 5x in 2m. Owner: Oncall Reliability Team. Due: 2026-03-14. Notes: thresholds to be tuned after mirror load tests.

Add automated mirror test in CI: nightly synthetic load to validate per-pool balancing, queue depth behavior, and KV cache effectiveness. Owner: SRE Testing (Ana Gomez). Due: 2026-03-22. Notes: test should exercise routing policies and the canary fallback path.

Post-deploy verification checklist and canary policy: require KPI checks for new runtime builds before promoting to Dedicated. Owner: Release Eng. Due: 2026-03-25. Notes: add gating in deployment pipeline.
Follow-up retrospective with PM and Support to refine customer communications and SLA impact assessment. Owner: Maya Chen (creator). Due: 2026-03-11.
